package rulefixtures

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for external_http_call_inside_transaction_scope: Network calls performed while a DB transaction is open.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.
type Rule032PositiveRecord struct {
	db *sql.DB
}

func scenario032Positive(ctx context.Context, repo Rule032PositiveRecord, paymentID int) error {
	tx, err := repo.db.Begin()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer tx.Rollback()

	resp, err := http.Get("https://api.payment-gateway.com/verify?id=" + http.StatusText(paymentID))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return nil
	}

	return tx.Commit()
}
